comparison.objective: Turn an amplifier volume down, insert a cable plug, restore the setting, and withdraw; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: One-hand stabilization with ordered knob rotation and connector insertion versus mandrel stabilization, hammering, and fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Plug inserted only while volume is down, original volume restored, and arms returned; detailed numeric seating/knob tolerances are absent. Candidate requires four valid fractures and complete containment.
comparison.reason: Shared stabilization is generic; ordered control adjustment and connector seating do not test impact fracture.
